newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-LIETUVA HOTEL SALE ANNOUNCEMENT NEXT WEEK.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-LIETUVA HOTEL SALE ANNOUNCEMENT NEXT WEEK.

text.p: Lithuania will open bidding for the country's largest hotel, the Hotel Lietuva, next week, a privatisation official said on Tuesday.
"We will decide in a couple of days how long the bidding will last," Alfredas Ramanauskas, deputy director of the privatisation department at the European Affairs Ministry, told Reuters.
Ramanauskas said the terms of reference for the hotel privatisation had been approved on Monday by the privatisation commission.
The hotel also said Monday that its net profit in the first half of the year fell to 614,000 litas from 662,000 litas in the same period of 1996.
The decline in profits came amid a rising room occupancy rate, which edged up to 28.5 percent in the first half of 1997 versus 26.2 percent in the same period in 1996.
The hotel reported a net profit of 817,000 litas and turnover of 10.7 million litas for 1996.
The 316-room Hotel Lithuania is 70.04 percent state-owned and has 344 employees.
